title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Usable Items, Manual, MP3s, and More

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】使用品とか説明書とかMP3とか
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Usable Items, Manual, MP3s, and More

blocks.source: 今回こそは開発記録らしく、最近やったことをまとめます。
blocks.translation: This time, in keeping with the spirit of a development log, I'll summarize what I've been working on recently.

blocks.source: 使用品の追加
blocks.translation: Adding Usable Items

blocks.source: 使用品を色々増やしました。魔物が落とすアイテムを使えば魔物専用技が使えます。……といっても、わざわざ使用品の枠を埋めてまで使う価値があるかは不明です。基本的にはおまけ程度ですので。
blocks.translation: I've added various usable items. Using items dropped by monsters lets you use monster-exclusive skills. That said, I'm not sure they're worth using up slots for usable items. Basically, they're just a little extra.

blocks.source: ひっそりと万歳ポーズも追加しました。魔法使用時や使用品の使用時にポーズをとります。
blocks.translation: I also quietly added an arms-raised pose. Characters take the pose when casting magic or using a usable item.

blocks.source: 魔物の落とす品が役立つかどうかはともかく、今回も使用品は地味ながら強力です。元々想定していたのは回復アイテムだけですが、それだけでも使いこなせばボス戦がグッと楽になるはず。
blocks.translation: Regardless of whether the items dropped by monsters are useful, usable items are once again modest but powerful. I originally only planned to include healing items, but even those alone should make boss battles considerably easier if used effectively.

blocks.source: 多くのＲＰＧでは回復アイテムを９９個まで使用できることも多いですが、あれは下手を打つとかなり泥沼化しますからね。特に全体回復、ＭＰ回復、蘇生辺りが野放図に使えると収拾がつきません。
blocks.translation: In many RPGs, you can often use up to 99 healing items, but if you make a mistake, that can quickly turn battles into a quagmire. In particular, if full-party healing, MP recovery, and revival can be used without restriction, things become impossible to control.

blocks.source: 昔の自分の作品でも多少その傾向はありましたが、当作品のボス戦は泥沼にならないようにできたかな、とは思っています。
blocks.translation: Some of my older works had a tendency toward that as well, but I think I've managed to keep the boss battles in this game from becoming quagmires.

blocks.source: 説明書の作成
blocks.translation: Creating the Manual

blocks.source: 忘れてはいけないのが説明書の作成です。ゲームシステムの説明は作中でもやっているのですが、段階を経て小出ししているため、情報が散らばらざるを得ません。いつでも、見れるようにまとめておく必要もあるでしょう。
blocks.translation: One thing I mustn't forget is creating the manual. The game systems are explained within the game, but because the information is revealed gradually in small portions, it inevitably ends up scattered. It needs to be compiled so that it can be viewed at any time.

blocks.source: 実際に作ってみると、結構色々と説明することがあるんですよね。シンプルにゲームシステムをまとめたつもりですが、全然シンプルじゃないかもしれません。まあ、今回は一人、二人と徐々に人数が増えていくので、そんなに混乱はしないと思っております。
blocks.translation: Once I actually started making it, I realized there was quite a lot to explain. I intended to summarize the game systems simply, but perhaps they're not simple at all. Still, the party gradually grows from one person to two and so on this time, so I don't think it will be too confusing.

blocks.source: MP3の作成
blocks.translation: Creating MP3s

blocks.source: Windows8の初期状態では、ゲーム中でMIDIが使えないという情報を頂いたので、とりあえず全曲をMP3化してみました。当初は気に入った曲だけMP3として、他はMIDIにする予定でした。
blocks.translation: I was told that MIDI cannot be used in games on a default Windows 8 installation, so I tried converting all the tracks to MP3 for the time being. Originally, I planned to make only my favorite tracks MP3s and leave the rest as MIDI.

blocks.source: なお、MIDIが使えないのはツクール２０００の話なので、ツクールＸＰ以降のようにDirectSoundsに対応した環境なら、演奏できるはずです。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, the issue of MIDI not working applies to RPG Maker 2000, so it should play in an environment that supports DirectSounds, such as RPG Maker XP and later.

blocks.source: 当たり前のようにMP3とかMIDIとかいった単語を使用していますが、一応説明しておきます。自分が長いこと親しんでいると「知っているのが当前」みたいになってくるんですよね。気をつけねばなりません。
blocks.translation: I use terms like MP3 and MIDI as though everyone knows them, but I'll explain them briefly just in case. When you've been familiar with something for a long time, you start to assume that everyone knows it. I need to be careful about that.

blocks.source: MIDI：演奏指令を登録したデータ。一言でいうとデジタルな楽譜。
blocks.translation: MIDI: Data containing registered performance instructions. In a word, a digital sheet of music.

blocks.source: 演奏はＰＣ環境に任せるので、ファイルサイズが軽い。
blocks.translation: Since the PC environment handles the playback, the file size is small.

blocks.source: MP3：演奏結果を録音した音声データ――をさらに圧縮した形式。
blocks.translation: MP3: A format that further compresses audio data containing a recording of the performance.

blocks.source: せっかくなので、町の曲を置いてみます。こんな感じに鳴り方が違うわけです。上がMIDI、下がMP3ですが、下手したら上が鳴らない環境の人もいるかもしれません。
blocks.translation: While I'm at it, I'll put up the town theme. This is the difference in how they sound. MIDI is on top and MP3 is on the bottom, but some people may be using environments where the top one won't play at all.

blocks.source: NR_town6.mid
blocks.translation: NR_town6.mid

blocks.source: NR_town6.mp3
blocks.translation: NR_town6.mp3

blocks.source: MP3にすることの利点は
blocks.translation: The advantages of converting to MP3 are

blocks.source: 環境に依存せず同一の音を鳴らせる。
blocks.translation: The same sound can be played regardless of the environment.

blocks.source: 大抵は音質がよくなる。
blocks.translation: The sound quality usually improves.

blocks.source: MP3にすることの欠点は
blocks.translation: The disadvantages of converting to MP3 are

blocks.source: ファイルサイズが重くなる。
blocks.translation: The file size becomes larger.

blocks.source: 綺麗にループできない。
blocks.translation: It cannot loop seamlessly.

blocks.source: 読込にわずかに時間がかかる。0.5秒ぐらい？
blocks.translation: Loading takes a little time—about 0.5 seconds?

blocks.source: 音色の調整など、作成に手間がかかる。
blocks.translation: Creating them takes time, including adjusting the tones.

blocks.source: 自分の中では、まずはファイルサイズの問題が重要で「全てMP3にするなんてとんでもない！」という感じだったのですが、よく考えると今の時代となってはそんなに気にすることでもないかもしれません。
blocks.translation: To me, the file-size issue was the most important thing, and I initially thought, "Converting everything to MP3 is out of the question!" But when I think about it, perhaps it's not something to worry about so much nowadays.

blocks.source: 試したところ、全曲MP3にしても60MBに納まる程度です。昔は60MBなんてフリゲを見ると「重すぎ。ユーザへの配慮がなってない」って感じでした。ウチなんてＤＬ速度が秒間64Kビット（=8KB）でしたから、うまくいっても二時間かかるという計算ですね。今なら、一分もかからない環境が当たり前ですが、いやはや便利な時代になったもんじゃ……。
blocks.translation: I tried it, and even with every track converted to MP3, it fits within about 60 MB. In the past, whenever I saw a freeware game that was 60 MB, I thought, "That's way too large. They have no consideration for their users." My download speed back then was only 64 kilobits per second (8 KB), so even under ideal conditions, it would have taken two hours. Nowadays, an environment where it takes less than a minute is standard. Goodness, what a convenient age we live in...

blocks.source: 将来的に作曲をやる人を除いて、MIDIは存在自体が忘れられていく気がします。というか既になっているかも。
blocks.translation: Except for people who plan to compose music in the future, I feel that MIDI itself will gradually be forgotten. In fact, it may have happened already.

blocks.source: ループの問題については、曲の終わり方を調整しておけば、そこまでの違和感はなさ気です。そもそもダンジョン曲なんかは、すぐ戦闘になるのでループが終わるまで聞くことが稀だったりします。
blocks.translation: As for the looping issue, adjusting how the track ends seems to prevent it from feeling too awkward. Dungeon themes in particular often lead into battle quickly, so it's rare to listen until the loop ends.

blocks.source: 一番、違和感があるのは流れが大事な戦闘曲なのですが、これは元から音質のためにMP3にする予定でした。ちなみにループ処理に適したOGGはツクール２０００では使えません。無念。
blocks.translation: The battle themes feel the most awkward, since their flow is important, but I had planned to convert those to MP3 for sound quality from the beginning. Incidentally, OGG, which is suitable for loop processing, cannot be used in RPG Maker 2000. What a shame.

blocks.source: 読込時間については気にならないこともないですが、それでも並のＳＦＣのＲＰＧよりはロードが速いはず。イベント時の曲変更で変な間ができないかも気になりますが、この辺は実際に二周目のテストプレイで感触を確かめてみるとしましょう。
blocks.translation: The loading time is not something I can ignore entirely, but it should still load faster than an average SNES RPG. I'm also concerned that changing music during events might create a strange pause, so I'll check how it feels during the second playthrough's actual testing.

blocks.source: 作成に手間がかかるのは僕が頑張ればよいだけなので、問題ありません。そこまでの手間でもないですし。
blocks.translation: The fact that creating them takes time isn't a problem, since all I have to do is work hard. It's not that much extra effort, either.

blocks.source: 最初はMIDIが鳴らない環境の人だけ、手動で入れ替えてください――って仕組みにしようと考えていたのですが手間ですよね。なので、音質などのメリットも考えて、普通に最初から全曲MP3でいいかって気がしています。おまけにMIDIを付けとくということで。
blocks.translation: At first, I considered having only people whose environments couldn't play MIDI manually replace the files—but that would be a hassle, wouldn't it? So, considering the benefits such as sound quality, I'm thinking it would be fine to simply use MP3 for every track from the start. I'll include the MIDI versions as an extra.

blocks.source: これにて１３７０時間経過。現在は二周目のテストプレイ中ですが、これ意外と気合がいるんですよね。作ったものを消化するだけなので、大したことないと思いがちなんですが、神経のアンテナを張り巡らして、気になったところがあれば直さねばなりませんから。
blocks.translation: That brings the total to 1,370 hours. I'm currently testing the second playthrough, but this takes more energy than you'd expect. It's easy to think it won't be a big deal since I'm merely going through what I've made, but I have to stay intensely alert and fix anything that catches my attention.

blocks.source: また、そのうちテストプレイヤーの募集をするかもしれません。さすがにこの規模の作品で身内のテストだけで済ませる度胸はないです。いえ、過去にやったんですけどね……。そりゃあもうバグどっさりで顔面蒼白でした。デバッガー的な詳細なプレイでなくとも、普通にプレイして普通にクリアできることを確かめてもらえれば、それだけでだいぶ安心できると思います。
blocks.translation: I may recruit test players at some point as well. For a project of this size, I don't have the nerve to rely solely on testing by people I know. Well, I did that in the past... and was left pale-faced by the mountain of bugs. Even without detailed, debugger-style playtesting, I think it would be very reassuring just to have someone confirm that the game can be played and cleared normally.

blocks.source: そんなわけで最近は「これが完成したら俺、一消費者に戻ってまったりするんだ……」という死亡フラグのようなことを考えながら、モチベにしています。開発の序盤・中盤で他にやりたいことを強く考え出したら、エターナルフラグ以外の何物でもないですが、もう大丈夫でしょう。
blocks.translation: Lately, I've been motivating myself by thinking things like, "Once this is finished, I'll return to being an ordinary consumer and take it easy..."—the sort of thought that sounds like a death flag. If, during the early or middle stages of development, I had started seriously thinking about other things I wanted to make, it would have been nothing but an eternal flag, but I should be safe now.

blocks.source: 常時目標に向かって努力しているのも疲れるので、たまには何も目指さず日々を送る幸せを噛みしめたいところです。それによる充電がまたきっと、次のプロジェクトへの再起につながると信じて……。
blocks.translation: Constantly striving toward a goal is tiring, so sometimes I want to savor the happiness of simply going through my days without aiming for anything. I believe that recharging in this way will surely help me rise again for the next project...
